capabilities: Open the assistant by typing /ai in a note
Ask questions to OpenAI language models
Add other notes as context for responses
Insert AI responses into the current note
extras: The README is mostly the default Obsidian plugin development template; the only plugin-specific content is the features, usage and requirements sections. The Demo Video section is empty and there are no screenshots. The OpenAI API key is configured in plugin settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so users must leave their notes to ask questions or manually copy answers back.
summary: AI assistant opened with a /ai slash command in notes that answers questions via OpenAI models and inserts responses into the note.
